Three.js 0.180.0
https://threejs.org/
https://registry.npmjs.org/three/0.180.0
MIT license: see LICENSE.txt.
Includes three.module.js, three.core.js, RoomEnvironment.js and RoundedBoxGeometry.js.
The addon import paths were adjusted to use the locally served three.module.js.
The npm package tarball was verified against its published SHA-512 integrity value.
